author: Zenko13
quote: Simply a masterpiece. They managed to preserve the essence of a 1998 game while still making this remake feel fresh. It's hard to explain, you feel like you're playing something entirely new, yet somehow so familiar at the same time. And keeping the entire original soundtrack was the cherry on top. A perfect 100 out of 100.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Zenko13
quote: 13 years and millions upon millions of dollars spent, only to deliver a game full of bugs, woke elements, and poorly optimized for consoles, struggling to run at a miserable 20–30 FPS. Sure, it may look incredible and feature plenty of gameplay mechanics, but the negatives far outweigh the positives. Just bad.
